stories.title: Huracán Simon se acerca a la costa de Jalisco como categoría 4: SMN

en.title: Hurricane Simon approaches Jalisco coast as Category 4: SMN
en.summary: Hurricane Simon was maintaining Category 4 strength and was expected to make landfall on Jalisco's coast this morning in the municipalities of Tomatlán and La Huerta, according to Mexico's National Meteorological Service coordinator.

stories.title: Campaña de Lula denuncia a Meta por interferencia electoral en Brasil

en.title: Lula's campaign accuses Meta of electoral interference in Brazil
en.summary: Brazil's president and reelection candidate Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's campaign filed a complaint alleging Meta interfered in the election by blocking his content promotion on Instagram and disrupting his account's reach.

stories.title: Verstappen logra pole y victoria en esprint

en.title: Verstappen achieves pole and sprint victory
en.summary: Dutch driver Max Verstappen won the sprint race and secured pole position for the Singapore Formula 1 Grand Prix, also reaching his 50th pole position in his career.

stories.title: Golpea huracán Isaías sureste de EU: 4 muertos; deja sin energía a 670 mil

en.title: Hurricane Isaías strikes US Southeast: 4 dead; leaves 670,000 without power
en.summary: Hurricane Isaías made landfall in the United States killing four people, and approximately 670,000 residents across Florida, Alabama, Georgia, and Mississippi remained without electricity after the storm weakened into a tropical cyclone.

stories.title: Autoridad saudita reporta 12 muertos y más de 300 heridos por ataque al aeropuerto de Riad

en.title: Saudi authority reports 12 dead and more than 300 injured in attack on Riyadh airport
en.summary: An attack on Riyadh airport resulted in twelve deaths and over three hundred injuries. Hospitals became overwhelmed with wounded transported by ambulances and helicopters.

stories.title: Decretan Alerta Roja en Colima y Jalisco por 'Simon'

en.title: Red Alert declared in Colima and Jalisco due to Hurricane Simon
en.summary: Civil Protection declared a Red Alert in Colima and Jalisco as Hurricane Simon approaches, halting activities and prompting evacuations.

stories.title: México en alerta por severidad extrema de Simon y Rachel que avanzan hacia costas de Colima y BC

en.title: Mexico on alert for extreme severity of hurricanes Simon and Rachel advancing toward Colima and Baja California coasts
en.summary: Mexico's weather service forecasts that Hurricanes Simon and Rachel will bring extraordinary rainfall and waves up to 8 meters high in coming hours.

stories.title: Deja 12 muertos y 309 heridos ataque en aeropuerto en Riad

en.title: Attack on Riyadh airport leaves 12 dead and 309 injured
en.summary: An attack on Riyadh's international airport resulted in at least 12 deaths and 309 injuries, with some victims sustaining serious harm.

stories.title: Huracán Isaías se cobra cuatro vidas y deja a unos 670,000 personas sin electricidad en EU

en.title: Hurricane Isaías kills four and leaves approximately 670,000 without power in the US
en.summary: Hurricane Isaías caused four deaths and left around 670,000 people without electricity across the United States, with limited search and rescue requests reported in Florida.

stories.title: Lula acusa a Meta de interferir en elecciones de Brasil; empresa rechaza señalamientos

en.title: Lula accuses Meta of interfering in Brazil's elections; company denies allegations
en.summary: Brazil's president alleges Meta restricted his campaign posts on Instagram before the October 25 runoff election, while the company states the accusations lack merit.

stories.title: Isaías toca tierra como huracán categoría 2 en la costa de EU

en.title: Hurricane Isaías makes landfall as Category 2 storm on US coast
en.summary: Hurricane Isaías made landfall Friday night as a Category 2 hurricane on the Gulf of Mexico coast of the United States.

stories.title: Huracán Simon categoría 4 amenaza al Pacífico mexicano; estos estados tendrán lluvias torrenciales

en.title: Hurricane Simon category 4 threatens Mexican Pacific; these states will have torrential rains
en.summary: Category 4 Hurricane Simon is approaching the coasts of Colima and Michoacán in Mexico, while tropical storm Rachel could impact Baja California during the night.

stories.title: Nerds llega oficialmente a México tras años de venta por distribuidores

en.title: Nerds officially arrives in Mexico after years of distributor sales
en.summary: Ferrara Candy Company's Nerds brand launched official operations in Mexico with a strategy combining diverse product formats and marketing activations to build consumer presence.

stories.title: Mantendrá México de las inflaciones médicas más altas en América Latina en 2027

en.title: Mexico to Maintain One of the Highest Medical Inflation Rates in Latin America in 2027
en.summary: Mexico is projected to have one of the highest medical inflation rates in Latin America in 2027, with increases far exceeding general inflation, though at a slower pace than 2026, continuing pressure on business and household budgets.

stories.title: Hacienda baja el IEPS para gasolinas, mientras el diésel va por su quinta semana con cuota cero

en.title: Treasury lowers IEPS for gasoline, while diesel reaches its fifth week with zero tax
en.summary: Mexico's Treasury reduced the special tax on gasoline for the week of October 10-16, with Magna gasoline taxed at 2.39 pesos per liter and Premium at 1.62 pesos, while diesel maintains zero taxation.

stories.title: De equipo de adolescentes a negocio de 490 millones: cómo los Azcárraga convirtieron al América en un imperio

en.title: From teenage team to 490 million business: how the Azcárragas turned América into an empire
en.summary: Club América has evolved from a sports team into a financial asset, with the Azcárraga family now seeking to monetize its fan base, stadium, and brand value.
